"If this hits and you have NO CARDS IN YOUR ARSENAL, you may put a card FROM YOUR HAND face down into your arsenal." It was SEARCH_DECK -- the DECK, not the hand, and a tutor rather than a move -- with 'face_down' unread, and it was mandatory where the card says "you may". The hand-to-arsenal move now exists (PUT_INTO_ARSENAL from:"HAND").

The gate was CARD_IN_ZONE amount:0. 'amount' is a legacy alias for count_gte, so that asked for "zero or more cards in your arsenal" -- true in every state, the exact opposite of the restriction. Zero is meaningless as a lower bound, so CARD_IN_ZONE now reads a bare amount:0 as "exactly none"; the two other cards in the corpus that author it (threadbare_tunic, invigorating_light_blue) both mean "no cards" too.
